source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enter BMC-Web -> click "SOL console", and chck that it should access to "Serial over LAN (SOL) console".

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- "SOL console": the SOL (serial-over-LAN) console from the BMC web. Agent can open the SOL console and send/read serial data; the SOL session itself is interactive and uses the virtual terminal.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the SOL console output + that keystrokes are echoed so user confirms the SOL console works.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: opening an SOL console grabs a session slot and may interfere with an active console; confirm the SUT is free.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL correctly flags browser/SOL-session dependencies and session-slot interference, but extends the source's icon-link/navigation check into sending and reading serial data. Keystroke echo tests interactive console behavior, can affect the host, and is not required by the preserved Procedure or link-only Criteria.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED adds strong channel, ownership, mapping and recovery controls but also turns the row into an end-to-end SOL prompt/echo test. This review retains its session safeguards while restoring the actual boundary: prove the icon reaches and initializes the intended SOL console, with passive output only if auto-connected; do not send input under this row.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 851/2291 accepts the interactive send/read premise without checking that the Master only says click the icon and access the console, and it does not distinguish link coverage from SOL transport/input coverage.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No sequence-1014 draft exists in the invalidated 1,000-record run.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves the link-focused Master source; ED-34 treats endpoint, session ownership and expected route as readiness inputs; ED-35 prohibits substituting broader interactive testing for the specified control without recording coverage difference; ED-38 requires explicit approval for service-impacting session acquisition, no automatic retry and engineer-owned verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify that selecting the BMC WebUI `SOL console` icon/link routes the authenticated user to the intended Serial-over-LAN console view and that the target page/terminal component becomes usable enough to establish the link's navigation outcome, without treating this row as a full SOL data-path or input test.
original_method: On the identified BMC WebUI build and approved role, record the current route and active SOL-session state, click the exact `SOL console` control once, and verify the expected route/page identity, terminal component initialization and any documented non-error ready state. If the page auto-connects, capture passive console output and close cleanly; send no keystrokes or commands.
manual_activity: The operator confirms that no one owns the SOL console, approves any auto-connect session acquisition and remains available to terminate an unintended session. Browser automation can click the exact link and validate route/component readiness; interactive input and full SOL function testing require a separate approved scope.
required_inputs: Exact BMC endpoint/certificate, controller identity, firmware and WebUI build
Account role and expected permission to see/use the SOL console link
DOM selector, expected destination route/page heading, terminal component and ready/error state
Vendor behavior stating whether selecting the link merely opens a page or automatically allocates/connects a SOL session
Current SOL session/owner/slot evidence, approved timeout and supported disconnect/close sequence
Alternate KVM/OOB recovery, protected credentials and console-output redaction rules
safety_requirements: Do not send serial keystrokes, commands, break sequences, reboot input, boot-menu input or login credentials; none are required to prove the source's icon link works.
Before clicking, identify whether the link auto-connects and consumes or preempts a SOL session. Obtain approval and confirm the target session is free if a connection will be created.
Bind the browser endpoint, BMC identity, role and expected SOL route so a generic terminal window or another system's console cannot be accepted as evidence.
If the SOL view passively exposes output, redact secrets and privileged boot data; do not capture more transcript than needed to establish target/ready state.
Do not clear BMC, SEL, host or console logs. Preserve session/audit events and compare them only as non-destructive evidence.
Click once and do not automatically retry on popup blocking, error, timeout or an unexpected session. Stop, terminate through the supported path if safe, verify ownership/reachability and escalate.
agent_execution_scope: Read the active-session status and UI role/route baseline without changing SOL or serial configuration.
Activate only the source-specified WebUI link once and verify browser gesture, route/page identity, terminal component load and documented ready/error state.
If the UI auto-connects, observe passively, record session identity/state and disconnect cleanly; do not inject any input or claim echo, receive/transmit or host-console functionality coverage.
Preserve and redact evidence, verify no session remains orphaned and report only facts; never issue DUT PASS/FAIL or retry automatically.
engineer_actions: Approve the expected SOL link destination/readiness signal and whether auto-connect behavior is permitted for this testcase.
Confirm session ownership/slot availability, timeout, clean-close method, alternate recovery and whether a separate interactive SOL functional test is required.
Review link/navigation and any passive session evidence, record explicitly uncovered input/data-path coverage and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Opening the page fits, but `send/read serial data` and keystroke echo exceed the Master. Those actions add host-console impact and prove a broader function than the icon-link Criteria, so they require a separately approved testcase or Project Override.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use browser automation to click the exact BMC `SOL console` link once, assert its expected route/page/terminal-ready state, passively record output only if connection is automatic, and close any created session through the supported UI without transmitting input.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The BMC Web SOL-icon target, link-workable Criteria, absent Script and 10/0-minute estimates remain preserved; interactive echo is recorded as non-equivalent additional coverage rather than silently added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Instrument the WebUI gesture-to-route/component sequence and, only when the vendor UI auto-connects, confirm bounded passive session establishment plus clean disconnect. Keep interactive SOL data-path testing separate.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact BMC WebUI/SOL implementation and account role identified by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, WebUI asset/build, terminal component and documented SOL session behavior.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor BMC WebUI SOL navigation/session documentation and Project role/session-ownership policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds objective route/component/session evidence and cleanup while preserving the original link check; removes unsupported keystroke injection from this row.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Successful link navigation does not prove SOL transmit/receive, host serial mapping, boot interaction, echo or sustained stability. Passive auto-connect proves only establishment/observation and those other functions remain unverified.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: UI identity/selector, expected destination/readiness, role, auto-connect behavior, session ownership, cleanup, recovery and evidence policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Even a navigation-only click may allocate a scarce console slot or reveal sensitive output; browser popup/security behavior can prevent the page from initializing without indicating a SOL transport defect.

project_override_considerations: A Project may expand this row into a full interactive SOL test only with an engineer-approved channel/host mapping, harmless stimulus, console owner, exact input, expected response and recovery. That extra coverage must be recorded separately and must not obscure the original icon-link result or permit arbitrary keystrokes.
expected_evidence: Target BMC/controller, firmware/WebUI build, certificate and authenticated role identity
Pre-click active SOL session/owner/slot state and documented auto-connect behavior
Redacted browser evidence of the exact SOL icon, single click, resulting route/page heading and terminal component ready/error state
If auto-connected: target/session identity, bounded passive output sufficient for correlation, start/end audit and supported clean disconnect
Proof no keystrokes/commands or configuration changes were sent, no session remains allocated and BMC/alternate OOB access remains healthy
Explicit statement that SOL transmit/receive/echo/host-input coverage is outside this row plus engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently describe a BMC WebUI SOL icon/link access check. DeepSeek and GPT V2 broadened it into interactive console testing, but that is a review-method overreach rather than a conflict in the preserved Master.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target control and expected navigation outcome are identifiable. UI route/readiness, role, auto-connect behavior and session ownership are normal Project readiness inputs; execution is gated under PACKAGE, not permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its browser/session-slot warning but removes unsupported send/read and echo activity from the approved method.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes its end-to-end interactive purpose to the source-faithful link/navigation boundary while retaining identity, ownership, redaction, alternate recovery and clean-termination safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Corrects its acceptance of interactive output as link evidence and explicitly records the uncovered functional SOL data path.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No prior invalid draft exists for this sequence.

review_improvement: Avoids injecting input into a live host console merely to prove a WebUI icon works, while still accounting for auto-connect session allocation and collecting objective gesture-to-destination evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A UI link test and a SOL transport test have different boundaries. The former checks event handling, routing, authorization and terminal-component initialization; the latter requires channel mapping, serial parameters, host state, transmit/receive stimuli and recovery. Because this Master mentions only clicking the icon and a workable link, sending keys would add risk and coverage not authorized by the source.
